svg.text: Strict Linear Communication Flow (No Tier Skipping) | Local Wi-Fi Decoupled Topology
Framed USB Serial / UART (@115200 baud, CRC-16 Checksum)
Raspberry Pi 4 Model B (4GB RAM, Linux OS, Local Communication Gateway)
• Ring Buffer in RAM (Zero Disk IO)
STRICT ENCLAVE ISOLATION: Robot (Pi 4) and AI Brain Laptop communicate EXCLUSIVELY with each other across this LAN
No Direct WAN/Internet Access from Robot | Zero Inbound Open Ports | Protected behind NAT Firewall
TIER 3: OFFBOARD EDGE AI BRAIN (LAPTOP — MVP ARCHITECTURE)
Host Laptop (Intel Core i7 / NVIDIA Dedicated GPU | Local AI Inference Engine)
• Bounding box overlay for emergency verification
• Fall triage conversational prompt: "Are you okay?"
• Aggregates Robot telemetry and AI inference
• ONLY device authorized to call Cloud Backend
MVP Architecture Notice: Offboarding to laptop minimises prototype cost (~Rs. 300k budget); production unit integrates AI compute directly onboard robot.
Outbound HTTPS REST Requests: GET /api/v1/schedules | POST /api/v1/dispense/confirm | POST /api/v1/alerts/fall | POST /api/v1/telemetry/vitals
TIER 4: CLOUD BACKEND & CAREGIVER MOBILE APP ECOSYSTEM
Distributed Cloud Services (AWS / Oracle Cloud) & Cross-Platform Flutter Mobile Client
Co-developed by Amodh Gunawardana & Nethum Liyanage
• PostgreSQL Database (Schedules, Adherence Logs, Vitals, Inventory)
• Twilio Emergency Telephony Gateway (Automated Voice Calls & SMS)
• Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) High-Priority Push Alerts
Developed by Thevindu Herath (UI/UX) & Sithil Hettiarachchi (Coding)
• Medication Schedule Management: Add / edit times and prescriptions
• Real-Time Medication Adherence: Verified pill taken status & history
• Low/Empty Restocking Alerts: Carousel cartridge refill notifications
• Live Vital Signs Dashboard: Continuous Heart Rate & Fever logs
• Emergency Fall Alarm: Instant push notification with posture preview
Public Marketing Landing Page (Status: COMPLETED & LIVE)
Live Production URL: https://carealvi.pages.dev | GitHub Organization: https://github.com/alvicare/carealvi
• Engineered by Amodh Gunawardana (PO / Technical Architect) — Sized 5 SP, Completed in Sprint 0 (Jira: SCRUM-30).
• Tech Stack: Next.js 14 App Router, React Three Fiber & Three.js (.glb 3D ALVI Model with scroll-scrubbed interactive animation).
• Early-Access Waitlist: Built with legal compliance under Sri Lanka PDPA No. 9 of 2022 & UK GDPR (Subtasks: SCRUM-31, 32, 33).
Scope Boundary: Web presence is strictly this marketing landing page; caregiver portal web app is deferred post-MVP.
